summary.exceptions_judged: 05d I3 asked: is any exception wider than its measured reason? (a) The common-word exception is computed from B's file and pinned to the measured words (asserted equal), as decisions/0109 О17 corrected says ('occurs inside B's own file texts'). «человек» and «Обучение» stand inside B's answers on the correct server; «Средний» stands only inside a rule text of B's file, which reaches B's result when that rule fires, so its exception rests on B's file, not on a measured answer. It is not wider in effect: check (2) sees any text of A inside a string of B's answers (O1 and O2-v3 red, below) and the list sees it as a whole value. The comment of assertNothingOf says such a word stands 'inside B's answers on the correct server', which holds for «Средний» only for B's possible answers (issue I4, a precision of a comment). (b) The composed fields: exactly version, lang and languages, top level of B's questionnaire answer, each asserted by value (O6 red: 'the field version'); measured, no other string of either answer is outside B's file. Not wider. (c) Membership in 'any field, any depth, any language' of B's file admits only B's own strings; a text of A that is also a string of B's file is not in the set of A by definition. Not wider. (d) Not an exception but a place no check reads: the KEYS of the JSON answers (finding F6).

findings.what: Criterion 6: B's network answers hold none of A's texts, and decisions/0109 (the addendum after the second pass) aims at 'a text of A of any length placed in B's answers'. Every check reads string VALUES only; no check reads the object keys of B's JSON answers (the raw-text search is kept only for A's solution names). A text of A that B's answer holds as a key is not seen. Own mutants, measured without a browser and run in Chrome: G01 (B's questionnaire answer gets seen = { «Учёт-Про»: 1 }, both pairs), G01-v3 (pair 2: { «Лидвейв»: 1 }), G02 (B's result answer: recommended[0].by = { <intro of A>: true }) survive isolation (9 of 9 green), while B's answer holds A's name or intro as a key. G08 is the same shape in B's answer to A's set: that answer is outside the criterion's own demand (no solution name of A), but inside the list rule that the addendum extends to it. Why Low: on the correct server the keys of B's answers are fixed field names (measured: the keys that are not keys of B's file are version, lang, languages, questions_min, questions_max, ai, leads and clear_leader, recommended, score, because, value, selected; none holds a text of A), the server builds both public forms field by field with named keys (public-data.js), so a key-only leak needs new code that keys an object by tenant text AND mixes tenants, and the page reads named fields only, so the visitor never sees such a key; every value-level leak is caught (17 mutants red).
findings.how_to_fix: In assertNothingOf, look for every text of A as a part of every object key of the parsed answer too (no exception is needed: on the correct server no key holds a text of A, measured in both pairs for all three answers); optionally assertOwnStrings also requires every key to be a key of B's tenant file or a field name of the public forms. Measured in a copy (the probe in summary.mutants.probe_of_the_fix): green 3 of 3 on the correct code; G01, G01-v3, G02, G08 red with 'a key holds the text of A'. Not blocking: ORCH records it for step 10 (a defect for TEST-DESIGNER, or a later edit of isolation checked again by step 5b).

issues.text: For ORCH (outside criterion 6 as written; not a finding of this gate): the page of B showing A's text on the screens after B's card is not checked. G05 (the page keeps the last tenant name in sessionStorage and names it on another tenant's result screen) and G06 (the page asks /t/<other tenant>/api/questionnaire for another sai-picker: key and appends the name to the question panel) survive isolation (9 of 9 green); the probe shows the leaks are real («Учёт-Про» on B's result screen; A's name SEEN on B's first question screen). Why outside: the page clause of criterion 6 describes B's page as opened after A's pass, the same moment as 'the storage still holds only A's key', which B's own pass would change (it saves B's key); the design (section 8, row 6) reads it as 'the card of B', and decisions/0109 О17 keeps 'the page text of B ... as before'. The requirement's own bar line says 'a second tenant does not show the first tenant's data, in the page', so ORCH may want the precision: a small, measured fix is to read B's page text on B's result screen (and on each question of B's pass) and to assert that B's page requests nothing under /t/<A>/; in a copy it is green 3 of 3 on the correct code and red under G05 and G06. If ORCH reads the page clause as every screen of B, this becomes a finding of the test (it would be Medium) and needs its own decision.

Outside criterion 6 as recorded: a response header. G04 (B's questionnaire and result answers carry a header X-Seen-Tenant with the UTF-8 bytes of A's name) survives; measured without a browser, the header decodes to «Учёт-Про» / «Лидвейв» and the bodies are unchanged. The requirement uses 'the answer' for the body (criterion 2 compares the answer the page received with the answer of a direct POST, deep-equal), decisions/0109 О17 reads 'hold none of them' over the string values of B's answers, and the kit records no response headers. If ORCH wants headers in criterion 6, the test can read the headers of a direct fetch of B's two answers.

Outside criterion 6: a number. G03b (the score of B's first recommended solution = the max of A's first number question, as a number) survives: criterion 6's set is A's strings (titles, question and option texts), and no check reads numbers. The same number turned into a string is read and red (G03: '«100000» at recommended[0].score is not a string of the tenant file of B').

A precision of a comment, not a finding: the comment of assertNothingOf (picker.e2e.js, lines 521-532) says a common word is compared with whole values 'because such a word stands inside B's answers on the correct server'. Measured: «человек» and «Обучение» do; «Средний» stands only inside rules[6].text of svet-marketing's file, which B's result carries when that rule fires, not in the answers of the leader set. The exception follows decisions/0109 О17 corrected (the words of B's file) and is pinned, and check (2) sees «Средний» inside any string of B's answers, so the test is right; the comment could say 'inside B's own texts (its file)'. For DOC-UPDATER or the next edit of the file.

A leak oracle over a JSON answer reads the places it names: string values at any depth were read by every check of step 05e (list, field equality, membership), object keys by none (F6); the page text was read on the first screen only (I1). Lesson: a leak check lists the places a leak can take (values, keys, headers, every screen the test shows) and reads each or records why not, with a mutant for each place.

Known and recorded for step 10, not of this change (I11 of step 05): the old test files leave folders in the system temporary root. My one npm run check added 203 (195 sai-wf06-*, 5 sai-outside-*, 2 sai-snap-*, 1 sai-flaky-*); none is made by picker.e2e.js or e2e-stand.test.js (no sai-e2e- or sai-stand-test- entry was added by any run of mine). sai-stand-test-lvEDJb of 2026-11-05 is still there, not touched.

All my series ran on one machine (macOS, Node 22.23.4, 10 cores): they prove the timing of this machine (AP-144). The new case of E2S-13 does not depend on timing: the stand-in is a child of the test process, which reaps it only when its event loop turns, and no loop turn happens between the SIGKILL of a stop() that does not wait and the check (V12-only2: 30 of 30 by the new check under 12 busy loops). The GitHub runner time of npm run -s e2e -- picker is not measured by me (decisions/0110: TEST-RUNNER and RELEASE-VALIDATOR); here 17090-17157 ms.
